description: Shared Renovate preset for LanNguyenSi repos: grouped weekly patch/minor updates, no automerge, majors and breaking updates only through the Dependency Dashboard.

packageRules.description: Dependency ranges in package.json move together with the lockfile; engines, Docker tags and setup-node keep their precision.
npm overrides are security pins owned by the CVE sweeps; Renovate never changes them.
engines is a contract with consumers; it changes only by hand.
One PR per week for all npm patch and minor updates.
One PR per week for all composer patch and minor updates.
One PR per week for GitHub Actions patch, minor and digest updates.
Breaking non-major updates (0.x minors, prerelease jumps) in any manager wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard, in their own group.
Package replacements (a dependency moving to a new package name) change code, not just a version; they wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
prisma and @prisma/* majors must move together.
@types/node follows the production Node runtime major; it moves with the runtime upgrades, never on its own.
The Node runtime major (Docker node image, setup-node, .nvmrc) moves in planned runtime upgrades, not through Renovate.
The Python runtime (Docker python image, setup-python) is a runtime upgrade even on a minor bump; it waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
